thread:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/2026-03-21-embed-allocator v2 -> prod (canary=5%) :white_check_mark:
Emma: saw the bot output, starting post-deploy smoke. canaries look clean in us-west so far
Raj: quick heads-up — eu-west synthetic embeddings p95 jumped from 120ms -> ~620ms right after rollout :thinking_face:
Oliver: logs? any 503s or timeouts?
Raj: no 503s, just higher latency and a few `kvcache miss` entries in the probe logs. pasted sample: ```2026-03-21T14:12:03Z probe[eu-west] p95=632ms kvcache_miss=0.47```
Maya: thanks. is this the new quantized variant or the same model image pinned?
Emma: this rollout switched to embed-alloc-v2 (quantized kernels) — we expected slight latency drop, not increase. Canary still 5% so we can act without user impact
Oliver: propose pin eu-west canary back to embed-alloc-v1 while we triage. keep us-west on v2 to collect perf delta.
Raj: +1. how do we pin? feature flag or routing?
Emma: routing policy supports per-region override. I can flip eu-west to v1 for the next 10m, then we reassess.
Maya: recommend also disabling KV prefill for v2 in eu-west while we investigate kvcache miss pattern. could be a warmup ordering bug.
Emma: actionable: (1) pin eu-west to v1 (2) disable v2 prefill in eu-west (3) extend canary to 20m once pinned. I'll run commands now.
deploy-bot: routing override applied: eu-west -> embed-alloc-v1 (canary now v1) :white_check_mark:
Emma: prefill flag disabled for v2 in eu-west: `--prefill=false` set on routing group eu-west.
Raj: immediate tiny improvement p95 -> 310ms. still above baseline but trending better.
Oliver: good. start triage checklist: collect kernel traces, profiler snapshot, and model-serving metrics for v2 in eu-west during the spike window.
Maya: I'll open an incident doc and add runbook steps. link: https://internal/incidents/INC-2026-317 (WIP)
Emma: also adding a short note to release notes: "embed-alloc-v2 rolled back in eu-west due to unexpected p95 regression; under investigation."
Raj: if we confirm kernel selection mismatch, plan will be hotfix rebuild + gradual canary. if not, rollback permanently for eu-west and coordinate dedicated patch release.
Oliver: who's owner for the hotfix? Raj takes lead, Emma coordinates rollout windows. Maya owns postmortem and monitoring alerts.
Emma: sounds good. tagging oncall for eu-west: @Oliver please watch dashboards for next 60m.
Oliver: watching. will call if any 5xx or coldstart regressions appear.
Raj: collecting traces now, will post a summary in 15m.
Maya: note for follow-up: add synthetic probe that verifies `kvcache_hit_ratio` per-region after deployments. low-effort guardrail.
Emma: added to backlog and will include as part of the next quick patch. for now, keep canary pinned and let us-west continue to collect perf metrics. updates in ~15. :thumbsup:
